description: Beyond overlap detection, identify semantic conflicts: structural expectations from different skills that are mutually exclusive (e.g., skill A requires folder structure X, skill B requires incompatible structure Y in the same location).

requirements.description: Analyze structural expectations across skills to identify mutually exclusive configurations. Compare folder structures, file patterns, and content requirements to detect scenarios where multiple skills define incompatible expectations for the same resources.
requirements.title: Semantic Conflict Detection

validation.notes: Verify conflict detection across multiple skills

title: Conflict Detection
